request.name: Configure Unprocessed Data Bucket

description.content:
This API configures a bucket to store unprocessed payloads.
While processing there could be reasons a payload cannot be processed (mismatched structure, corrupted archive format, etc),
if configured the payload would be uploaded to the bucket for verification.

query.description: (Required) Name of the Object Storage bucket. Bucket name can be obtained by running 'oci os bucket list --namespace-name <namespace> --compartment-id <compartment>'. The json output 'name' parameter value contains the bucket name.
